scales.h1: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-bold tracking-tight text-neutral-900

spacing_and_layout.generous_spacing: Use p-6 to p-8 for standard containers, gap-4 to gap-8 for bento grids.
spacing_and_layout.border_radius: Rounded-lg (8px) for inputs/buttons, rounded-xl (12px) for cards/modals.
rtl_guidelines: Use Tailwind logical properties strictly: ps-* (padding-start), pe-* (padding-end), ms-* (margin-start), me-* (margin-end).
Icons adjacent to text must use ms-2 or me-2 respectively, or flex gap.
Ensure back/forward direction icons are horizontally flipped for RTL.
Sidebar should be positioned on the right edge of the screen.

patterns.main_dashboard: Grid-based bento layout. Top sections for key metrics (Pending Approvals), lower sections for live process logs.
patterns.linear_inbox: High-density list view. No vertical borders, subtle horizontal border-b. Split-screen (master-detail) when clicking a task.
patterns.workflow_canvas: Full width/height absolute area. Background is neutral-50 with a subtle dot grid pattern. Floating toolbar.
patterns.notion_form: Block-based, whitespace heavy. Invisible input borders until hover/focus.
patterns.chat_interface: Minimalist chat bubbles, edge-to-edge layout, quick-action suggestions.

components.buttons: Flat design, primary black (#171717) with white text, secondary outline or ghost. No heavy shadows.
components.cards: 1px solid border-neutral-200, flat white background, no drop shadow. Clean and architectural.
components.inputs: Minimalist. Linear-style: background transparent, border bottom or subtle full border on focus.
components.workflow_nodes: Draggable cards with clearly marked connection ports. Top border colored to indicate node type (e.g., trigger, action, condition).

motion_and_interactions.hover: Background shifts to neutral-50/100, border color darkens. scale-105 for interactive canvas nodes.
motion_and_interactions.focus: Visible focus ring: focus:ring-2 focus:ring-neutral-200 focus:outline-none.

image_urls.description: Minimal workspace for empty dashboard or inbox state
Abstract monochromatic curve for login or workflow cover

testing.attributes: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute. Use kebab-case, role-based names (e.g., data-testid='approve-task-button').

instructions_to_main_agent: Apply `dir='rtl'` to the root html/layout element. Ensure all layout directions flow right-to-left natively.
Use Tailwind logical properties strictly (e.g., pe-4, ms-2, border-s) instead of physical ones (pr-4, ml-2, border-l).
Integrate a Jalali calendar library (e.g., date-fns-jalali or moment-jalaali) for date picking and display.
Ensure Vazirmatn font is loaded and set as the default sans-serif font.
For the visual workflow builder, consider utilizing reactflow or similar, applying custom node styling that matches the monochromatic card design.
Keep styling flat, minimal, and monochromatic. Avoid unnecessary shadows and gradients.
Apply `data-testid` to all interactive elements as strictly requested.
Build the components in .js files (not .tsx) as specified by the project setup constraints.

Ensure the following pages/views are created: Main Dashboard, AI Chat-to-Process Interface, Interactive Visual Workflow Builder (Canvas), Notion-Inspired Form Builder, Linear-Style Task Inbox, Real-time Process Monitoring & Analytics, Mobile Quick-Approvals.
